business_summary.text: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited is engaged in railway systems manufacturing and has a wholly owned subsidiary, Titagarh Naval Systems Limited, focused on shipbuilding and maritime systems.

call_points.text: TNSL is setting up a brownfield shipyard at Falta with total capex planned at ~₹600 crores.
Freight rail FY27 target set at 650-700 wagons per month based on current orders.
Passenger rail dispatches targeted to ramp up to at least 200 coaches in FY27.

operating_notes.text: Titagarh Naval Systems Limited is developing a modern shipyard at Falta, West Bengal, spread over approximately 50 acres with an annual capacity of 12-16 vessels.
FY26 dispatches at 7,019 wagons due to wheelset and west asia supply chain constraints.
TNSL has an approximate order book of ₹500 Cr (including taxes) for its shipbuilding and maritime systems business
Freight Rail Systems revenue stood at ₹505.31 Cr and Passenger Rail Systems at ₹229.75 Cr for Q1FY27.
Approved vendor status for 3-phase asynchronous traction motor type 6FRA-6068 with 1,200 units per annum capacity.
Titagarh Rail Systems and BHEL formed a 50:50 JV for Vande Bharat trainset maintenance.
Titagarh Rail Systems and BHEL signed a maintenance contract and executed a 50:50 JV agreement for the 35-year maintenance of 80 Vande Bharat sleeper trainsets.
Additional order for 4,955 BOXNHL wagons placed by Ministry of Railways taking total order to 9,994 wagons.

timeline.summary: Titagarh Naval Systems launched the fourth Diving Support Craft A23 for the Indian Navy on 19th April 2026.
Titagarh Rail Systems filed the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26 showing zero utilization of ₹199.99 Cr preferential warrant proceeds.
Titagarh Rail Systems submitted its annual promoter share encumbrance disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI SAST Regulations for FY26.
Aditya Purohit, CFO, shared Q4 & FY2026 earnings call audio link on 1 June 2026 via company website.
Titagarh Rail Systems reported a total order book of ₹27,540 Cr and positive operating cash flow of ₹311.28 Cr for FY26.
Titagarh Rail Systems submitted the Q4 & FY26 earnings call transcript on June 3, 2026.
Titagarh Rail Systems submitted its annual promoter share encumbrance disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI SAST Regulations for FY26.
Titagarh Naval Systems launches fifth and final Diving Support Craft for Indian Navy on 1 August 2026
Titagarh Rail Systems submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, showing ₹50 Cr utilized from the preferential warrants issue.
Titagarh Rail Systems announced its inclusion in the Indian Railways approved vendor list for 3-phase locomotive traction motors with a 1,200 units per annum capacity.
Titagarh Rail Systems inaugurated new Design & Operations Centre at Uttarpara, WB on 21 August 2026
2026-08-25: Titagarh Rail Systems signs non-binding MoU with Siemens to explore global metro projects
2026-09-07: Board approved discontinuation of non-operational JV with Mermec, fixed dividend record date and convened AGM
Titagarh Rail Systems signed a JV agreement with BHEL to undertake 35-year maintenance for Vande Bharat trainsets.

Titagarh Rail Systems and BHEL signed a definitive contract and executed a 50:50 joint venture agreement for the 35-year maintenance of 80 Vande Bharat sleeper trainsets as part of the ₹24,000 Cr order.
Titagarh Rail Systems Limited’s 29th AGM on September 30, 2026, approved all seven resolutions with majority shareholder votes, including financial statements and director re-appointment.
Titagarh Rail Systems received an additional order worth ₹1,717 Cr from the Ministry of Railways for 4,955 BOXNHL wagons.
